svg.aria-label: Cross-section of a leaf: waxy cuticle, upper epidermis, palisade mesophyll of tall cells packed with chloroplasts, spongy mesophyll with air spaces, a vascular bundle containing xylem and phloem, lower epidermis with guard cells around a stoma. Light enters from above; carbon dioxide diffuses in through the stoma; oxygen and water vapour diffuse out.
